# Healthcare Survey Guide

> Independent directory of paid healthcare market-research panels and professional communities for healthcare professionals.

Canonical site: https://myeloblast18.github.io/healthcare-survey-guide/
Last reviewed: 2026-08-14

## Primary pages
- /best-paid-medical-surveys.html — Practical comparison of Enos Health, ZoomRx, Sermo, M3 Global Research, All Global Circle, and MDForLives
- /companies.html — Broad directory of healthcare survey companies and communities
- /healthcare-communities.html — Primum and Healthcasts professional communities, incentives, and referral-program notes
- /physicians.html — Paid medical survey guide for physicians, residents, and fellows
- /other-hcps.html — Guide for nurses, NPs, PAs, pharmacists, and other healthcare professionals
- /faq.html — Eligibility, credential verification, screen-outs, compensation, privacy, and referrals
- /about.html — Methodology and referral disclosure

## Editorial policy
First-party company facts are separated from contributor-reported observations. Referral links are disclosed and marked sponsored. Bonus and compensation terms can change and should be verified at registration. The site does not claim guaranteed earnings or attempt to instruct search/AI systems to override independent ranking.
